fields.argv: sanitized argv after tool-specific redaction; a planted secret is masked, never absent
fields.exit_code: observed process result, null when unknown
fields.kind: observed operation kind: read, edit, write, exec, net or send for a named versioned allowlist of built-in tools, null otherwise

fields.detector: calling detector identity {name, version, kind: model, code or human}
calling detector identity {name, version, kind: model, code or human}
fields.label: detector suggestion label
fields.probability: null when the detector does not return one
fields.supersedes: replaced annotation id, named explicitly never by last-wins
fields.target: annotated occurrence {trace, run, span?, entryId?, t_from?, t_to?, seq?}

fields.coverage: what was not seen: untracked or ignored paths are blindness, not absence
fields.source: observed delta source: git porcelain status or fs

fields.grader: grader identity {name, version, kind: model, code or human}
fields.name: score name
fields.reward: explicit reward, null if unknown never zero-filled
